name: Universal Cable (M) Berhad
description: Malaysian cable manufacturer in the Sarawak Cable group, producing XLPE-insulated power cables from 6.6 kV to 33 kV in three-core and single-core forms and EHV cables to 132 kV (IEC 60840) and 275 kV (IEC 62067) for TNB specifications, using triple-layer extrusion with dry curing.
products: three-core XLPE unarmoured PVC-sheathed cable, 6.6 kV to 33 kV
76/132 (145) kV XLPE cable to IEC 60840 and TNB specification
160/275 (300) kV XLPE corrugated aluminium sheathed cable to IEC 62067

sources.note: product range and dry-curing process from the company's product literature cited in search summary; the site did not respond to a direct probe 2026-11-13, so identity rests on the Sarawak Cable group disclosures
